risk_summary: The excerpt provides meaningful operating, reserve, production, expense, and borrowing-base metrics, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and management estimates. Key risks include commodity-price volatility, liquidity and borrowing-base dependence, acquisition execution, covenant compliance, and reserve or asset-retirement estimation uncertainty.
